patterns_discovered.description: Path validation occurs before any file operations; all paths resolved with path.resolve() before use
patterns_discovered.evidence: Section emphasizes 'Validate target directory' as step 1 of bootstrap sequence; explicit mention of checking existence, permissions, and writeability

patterns_discovered.description: Bootstrap steps follow dependency order (app directory created before subdirectories, dependencies installed before verification)
patterns_discovered.evidence: Bootstrap Sequence lists 5 ordered steps with numbered dependencies; app directory explicitly marked 'create first (Next.js requires this)'

patterns_discovered.description: Each positive requirement has a corresponding anti-pattern explaining what NOT to do and why
patterns_discovered.evidence: Paired sections: Path Validation paired with anti-pattern about process.cwd(); bootstrap sequence paired with anti-patterns about directory creation scope

patterns_discovered.description: Failures should report exact state (which directories created, which failed) rather than generic errors
patterns_discovered.evidence: 'Partial directory creation' failure mode; error messages must show 'the invalid path'; ENOENT errors must not be suppressed

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Working Directory vs. Project Root Confusion
gotchas_discovered.description: process.cwd() is NOT the project root being bootstrapped; must explicitly resolve target path from actual working directory
gotchas_discovered.context: Listed as explicit anti-pattern; critical for scenarios where bootstrap is invoked from different working directories

gotchas_discovered.description: Temptation to fall back to current directory silently when path resolution fails; this masks setup errors
gotchas_discovered.context: Listed as Common Bootstrap Failure and Anti-Pattern; emphasized as 'make path resolution explicit and loud'

gotchas_discovered.description: If bootstrap fails mid-sequence, partial directories remain; previous implementation likely didn't clean up or report this
gotchas_discovered.context: Listed as Common Failure; implementation must track which step succeeded and which failed for proper error reporting

gotchas_discovered.description: Bootstrap should fail fast if target parent doesn't exist; must not attempt to create parent directories
gotchas_discovered.context: Guidance emphasizes 'failing early prevents partial directory creation'; suggests previous implementations may have created parent directories
